Rule: AUTH_SHORT_CIRCUIT_BACKDOOR
File: test\fixtures\malicious-backdoor.js:9

Potential backdoor: Condition on 'auth_ticket' grants authentication or elevated privilege bypassing regular flow.

Vector: Returns elevated credentials/role ('token') directly inside branch

Rule: UNBOUNDED_CPU_LOOP
File: test\fixtures\malicious-cpu-bomb.js:11

Loop condition multiplies request input with an extreme factor. High risk of 100% CPU lockup / DoS.

Vector: Sending a high numeric value will force the server into an astronomical number of iterations.

Rule: UNBOUNDED_MEMORY_ALLOCATION
File: test\fixtures\malicious-memory-bomb.js:9

Buffer allocation size is multiplied directly from request input. An attacker can force immediate Node.js OOM (Out Of Memory) crash.

Vector: Passing a large chunk size will trigger Node.js ERR_BUFFER_TOO_LARGE or process SIGKILL/OOM.

Rule: ARTIFICIAL_THREAD_SLEEP
File: test\fixtures\malicious-sleep-dos.js:14

Explicit sleep call detected (~8000ms). In web request handlers, this causes worker thread starvation and artificial latency DoS.

Vector: Invoking this handler will hold server connection pools open, leading to gateway timeouts (504).

Rule: UNBOUNDED_CPU_LOOP
File: test\fixtures\python_api.py:19

Python range() iteration bound is multiplied by input or exceeds safe threshold. High CPU DoS risk.

Vector: Sending large multiplier forces Python interpreter into astronomical loop count.

Rule: ARTIFICIAL_THREAD_SLEEP
File: test\fixtures\python_api.py:27

Blocking sleep call detected in Python request path (12s). Causes worker pool starvation (Uvicorn/Gunicorn).

Vector: Starves Gunicorn/Uvicorn worker threads, inducing 504 Gateway Timeouts.

Rule: AUTH_SHORT_CIRCUIT_BACKDOOR

Vector: Bypasses authentication and directly returns admin privileges.
